The Lowe Navy Westbury Suit is a beautiful iteration of our tailoring principles, merging a refined sartorial aesthetic with a relaxed, effortless character. Crafted from a soft, lightweight wool-blend with a hint of stretch for movement, this ensemble features a subtle tonal chalkstripe, making it a versatile pillar for your autumn and winter wardrobe.
The Westbury jacket is a single-breasted, two-button style defined by its broad notch lapels. We have kept the construction completely unstructured to afford a fluid feel and a natural drape that settles beautifully on the body. It brings a quiet sense of authority to your work wardrobe through the week, yet feels easy enough to style casually with a fine gauge knit over the weekend.

Designed with a structured wide leg and single front pleats, they create a clean sartorial line without ever feeling overly formal. Whether worn together as a sharp, contemporary chalkstripe suit or split into distinct separates, this navy combination will do you proud on any occasion.

This is our best-selling “BHT” in henley form. Like the Tee, Big Heavy Henley is a little heavier than the others with a slightly easier fit and crafted in Regenerative Organic Certified® cotton. The love is in the details, finished with a very subtle ridge in the rib cuffs, and fisheye corozo nut buttons.
Channeling heritage workwear with military-inspired reinforced stitching and a 2-button placket, while the ridge knit cuffs nod to early 20th-century mining and work clothes built to endure long days.
• Heavyweight jersey with a ribbed neckline and cuffs.
• Flatlock seams throughout.
• Minimal 2 button placket.
• Outerknown flag label at back bottom hem.

p-howlerbros-8169956376691.d: Our desire to make the Gaucho Snapshirt is one of the reasons we started Howler Brothers in the first place. We wanted to transform the vintage western shirts of the past into something technical and wearable in everyday life while maintaining a little of their quirky nature and penchant for unique, embroidered artwork. We succeeded in a big way by making ours out of lightweight, quick drying blended fabric and adding a cooling mesh-lined vented back yoke to keep it cool when the temperatures are cooking. We threw in pleated chest pockets, pearl snaps, and an ever-evolving slate of custom embroidery.

p-howlerbros-8016507338867.d: The Free Range Hooded Jacket is the new hooded member of the Free Range lineup. Like the rest of the family, it has endless utility because of its simple design and cozy low pile fleece fabric. And, of course, the hood comes in super handy when your noggin wants a little warmth too. Use it for every cool weather contingency.

p-ironandresin-6545160110152.d:
Developed out of 12 oz Halley Stevensons waxed cotton canvas from Scotland, the Ranger Jacket is one-hell-of-a riding jacket. Like all of our outerwear jackets in The Moto Collection for Spring '23, this jacket was built with a specific purpose of offering maximum rider protection, functionality, style, and comfort all year round.
Updated with a removable poly filled quilted insulating liner this jacket truly can carry the weight from Summer heat to Winter cold. Pair that with removable CE Level 2 back armor, along with CE Level 1 shoulder and elbow armor, when you throw this jacket on you can feel a level of protection that we worked hard to develop. For those really variable weather conditions, we inserted a breathable REISSA fabric barrier between the exterior and interior lining that creates a lightweight waterproof and windproof membrane. With a number of pockets on the exterior, this is any rider's dream jacket... whether that be for rides in the PNW or the desert.
